steps.title: Check work surface
steps.instruction: Inspect the work surface for clutter and obstructions.
steps.captureInstruction: Frame all required items clearly in one photo.
visualCriteria: The full work surface is visible.
A clear central working area is available without loose debris or unrelated clutter.
